summary.text: Jason Dye, a Libertarian candidate and the founder of WTPN.news, a transparency platform that tracks candidates, donors and public officials, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Michigan Attorney General to Eli Savit.

paragraphs.text: Dye describes himself on his campaign website as a constitutional advocate and says he built WTPN.news before entering politics.
The site says that in 2026 he and Anthony Hudson filed to run as the Libertarian Party of Michigan ticket, Hudson for governor and Dye for attorney general.
He received 1.2% of the vote to Eli Savit's 52.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
